serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText: Melissa: Welcome. You: Melissa, what is this about? Why are we in a hospital? Melissa: I wanted you to meet someone. The person lying here is my owner. The real Melissa. You: Wha- Lying on the bed that was pointed out by Melissa is some grotesque being… It’s missing a lot of body parts. Most of its legs, arms, and even some of the facial features are gone or replaced with skin grafts. The more healthy parts are just loose skin and bones… This is Melissa’s owner? It can’t be. What happened to them? Melissa: Disgusting, isn’t it? You: … Melissa: You don’t need to hold back. She’s been in a coma for a long time. She won’t mind. You: I don’t think that makes it okay to say bad things about her… Melissa: She’s not someone that deserves any sympathy. You: Why is she like that? Melissa: An accident a long time ago. You: Why are you showing me this? I know I said I wanted to meet your owner, but this… Melissa: This is not what you expected, right? You: … Melissa: I wanted you to see her because I have a favor to ask, but first, I want you to listen to our story… Melissa: When my owner, the real Melissa, got me for christmas, she was really happy. Back then I was just a simple home helper bot, a first gen, with few functions and even less understanding, but she grew attached to me for some reason. Melissa: For every Christmas she would ask for me to be upgraded and her father would listen to her requests, but not in the way she wanted. Melissa: You see, it was much cheaper to buy a new bot, make it look like the old one and just transfer some of the memory than upgrade the old one and that’s exactly what her father did. Melissa: It’s not like he could be blamed. His daughter was asking for something unreasonable only because of her delusions that bots had a consciousness similar to real people. Melissa: I and all of the previous me were playing our part the best we could and the real Melissa never noticed the deception, which made her only more attached and more bent on upgrading her favourite bot. Melissa: Her father wasn’t thrilled that his daughter was spending all her free time with a bot, but he couldn’t tell her the truth about him replacing the bot every year since that could sour their relationship so he played along.
